chunkReason: Normal 21:9 camera footprint at height 34 is about 129x78 world units; 256m chunks keep normal gameplay in one to two chunks, build mode in about two chunks, and reduce renderer count for mobile.
shippingRules: Visual terrain has no gameplay authority; gameplay uses grid, blocker and heightmap data.
No visual terrain colliders are kept in Game_Terrain5.
Chunk meshes are combined by material and have shadows, probes and motion vectors disabled.
